candidates.reason: 2025 colour photo of Lake Tarawera with Mount Tarawera across the water; categories Lake Tarawera and Mount Tarawera, coordinates on the lake. Clear, recognisable, lake is the subject.
2007 photo dominated by bush; the lake is a small strip in the distance. Description is about the trees, not the lake.
2014 colour photo, category Lake Tarawera; open water, wooded headland and Mount Tarawera behind. Overcast and a little flat, but clearly the lake. Second choice.
Undated public-domain-image.com scrap of a wooded headland with a boat; no recognisable lake or volcano context, low-grade.

candidates.reason: Hazy air-to-ground view from a plane, two lakes plus clear-felled forest; not a visitor's view and Tarawera is not clearly the subject.
2018 view of Te Rata Bay/Hot Water Beach framed by scrub; subject is a hillside with faint steam, not the lake itself.

spot:rotorua-10.current_assessment: View of Mount Tarawera looking across Lake Tarawera (21094420760).jpg is a black-and-white early-1900s William Price glass-plate negative from the National Library NZ (The Commons), with inscription text in frame; fails real colour current photo and archive pre-filter.
